svg.data-weight: 8.07 kg (17.79 lb) with no supply; 9.20 kg with one AC supply and 9.23 kg with one DC supply, Table 13
svg.data-power-input-dc: 20.4 through 72 VDC at the terminal block, nominal +24, -48 or -60 VDC (Table 36)
svg.data-cooling: fanless, convection cooled (Table 12); one rack unit clear above and below
svg.data-operating-temp: -40 to 60 C in a sealed enclosure, -40 to 70 C in a ventilated enclosure (40 LFM) and -40 to 75 C in a blower-equipped enclosure (200 LFM), up to 15000 ft; safety certified at 60 C
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 85 C in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation up to 15000 ft (4572 m)
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 EX4100, EX4100-F and EX4100-H switches; the four VCP cages are the Virtual Chassis ports (HiGig or HGoE mode, or uplink ports) and the four uplink cages support HGoE only. A 10GBASE-T transceiver cannot form a Virtual Chassis in a VCP
svg.data-macsec: the four uplink ports are MACsec capable
svg.data-dry-contact-alarm: two alarm inputs (5 V threshold) and one alarm relay output (NO, COM, NC), Table 4
svg.data-optics-sfp: the 24 front cages take 1 Gbps SFP transceivers; Tables 49 and 50 list the industrial-grade 1 G optics against the ambient they allow. The supported list is in Juniper's Hardware Compatibility Tool, which the guide names and which is not held here
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: the eight group cages take 1 Gbps SFP and 10 Gbps SFP+ transceivers; Tables 45 to 48 list the industrial-grade 10 G and 10GBASE-T optics against the ambient they allow. The supported list is in Juniper's Hardware Compatibility Tool, which the guide names and which is not held here
